hook: A specialized AI engine solved 78 percent of 200 construction tasks.

sections.voiceover: A specialized AI engine solved 78 percent of 200 construction tasks.

sections.visual_cue: Animated timeline showing October 2026 release of Magpie 3.0 and the institutional emblem of California Polytechnic State University.

sections.voiceover: Magpie 3.0 finished 18 percentage points higher than standard models. Construction Metrics documented the benchmark results across all 200 tasks. Procore AI scored a 78 percent success rate across 200 construction tasks during benchmark testing.
